notes: Replace expected_thread_ids with one or more real thread_ids from your indexed mailbox. Call search_emails or list_threads through your MCP client to discover thread ids.

A question that needs several sources. Use required_evidence instead of expected_thread_ids: every inner list is required, and any one thread id inside a list satisfies it. Here the flight thread is needed, plus either of two threads that both carry the hotel booking. Evidence recall counts how many of the lists are found.
